## RCA and fix (debugging protocol, phases 1-4)

**Observed (read-only SSM, 2026-11-04, rebar-mcp-fe6c2100292c-8093):** the container mounts only `gerrit_mcp_tickets` (at the tracker `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets`), `gerrit_mcp_code`, `/var/lib/rebar` and 2 secrets. `/var/gerrit/site/.rebar` does not exist. The tracker's git dir on the volume already holds `rebar-compact-intents/`, `rebar-fetch.lock`, `rebar-git-op.lock`.

**Frequency** (MCP clone reflog 2026-08-27..2026-11-03, 633 COMPACT commits, 90 bursts, 233 deploys): 49 deploys followed by a folding sweep before the next deploy; 26 of those were less than 6 h after the previous sweep (upper bound; the per-ticket arm also fires, and no-op sweeps leave no commit). Overlapping sweeps: 0 observed. The journal since Gerrit 3300 holds no sweep lines; a successful sweep logs nothing.

**Precedent:** `intangible-ladyish-vicuna` keyed the sidecars on the store; `push_state.py` and the fold intent journal already keep store state in the tracker's git dir. So the lock and stamp move there (`rebar-compact-worker.lock`, `rebar-compact-sweep.stamp`). `doctor_locks` derives the row from the trigger's helper. 3276's `stop_local_sweep` already refuses an "other pid namespace" stamp, and its commit message assumes a shared stamp, so retirement still signals only its own worker. The stamped lock reclaims a foreign-namespace holder only after the existing 1 h ceiling.

**RED -> GREEN:** new tests/unit/test_compact_trigger_shared_sidecars.py (2 bounded child processes, one store, different `.rebar`): 4 failed before the fix (both acquired; new process read stale; paths in `.rebar`), 4 pass after. 13 existing tests failed only on location (plain-dir stores without `.git`, hard-coded `.rebar/compact-worker.lock`) and were updated to derive the path. Targeted: 205 passed (14 modules), 402 passed (29 compaction/MCP/close modules). `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass; mechanism marker added, old `lock::compact-worker.lock` drained from the baseline.
